g.text: Figure 2b — Hexagonal architecture — ports and adapters
Hexagonal architecture is the architectural style, not a GoF pattern.
- Adapter: infrastructure implementations translate external/framework APIs to ports.
- Strategy: alternate implementations are selected behind stable port contracts.
- Facade/application service: coarse-grained use cases orchestrate several ports
without exposing that choreography to the HTTP adapter or UI.
HTTPS only when live adapter selected
